judgment.reasoning_summary: The cake is 5 units by 10 units, giving it an area of 50 square units. To divide it into 50 pieces of 1 square unit each, we need to make cuts that will create 50 smaller rectangles. Since the cake is already 50 square units in area, we can achieve this by making 4 cuts along the length (10 units) and 4 cuts along the width (5 units), resulting in a total of 8 cuts. This ensures that each piece is 1 square unit.
